name: Pizza Hutch
address: 8842 Frontage Access Loop, Pad C, Behind the Former Sears, Grantwood Meadows
about: Pizza Hutch has pursued crust innovation continuously since 1993 and has not identified a stopping condition. Every crust manufactured at this location contains at least one additional crust, per internal standard PH-9. Dine-in seating remains available but is no longer recommended.
announcement: NOTICE: The salad bar remains under sneeze-guard supervision. Return trips are metered.

reviews.name: Dwayne K.
reviews.text: Ordered Depth Two. Opened the crust and there was another pizza in there, exactly as described. No complaints, no surprises.

reviews.name: Marisol T.
reviews.text: The Cistern arrived at the correct temperature and the correct depth. My table did not survive it, which is on me.

reviews.name: Ronnie P.
reviews.text: I declined the box and was billed more than the box costs. The Slinger explained the policy while standing on my porch and it made sense at the time.

reviews.name: Aunt Vergie
reviews.text: The Perpetual Stick is thirty inches long and does not end where you think it ends. Excellent value per foot.

reviews.name: Tobias W.
reviews.text: Wings were listed as an afterthought and arrived as one. The stained-glass lamp photo they enclosed was a nice touch.

menu.name: The Recursive Crust Program
menu.blurb: Each pie contains a smaller pie. Depth is elective. Depth is billed.

items.name: The Original Hutch Recursion
items.desc: A pepperoni pan pie whose outer crust is stuffed with a complete second pie, sealed and baked in place. The second pie's crust is itself stuffed, though we do not photograph that part.
items.imagePrompt: Ultra-premium commercial food photography for a delivery-app menu tile. Subject: a thick pepperoni pan pizza whose swollen outer crust ring is stuffed with a second, smaller sealed pizza, the ring split open at one point to reveal molten cheese and a miniature crust nested inside it. Cheese sags in long strands over the rim, pepperoni cups pooled with orange oil, visible steam. Three-quarter hero angle on a chrome pizza stand set on a red-and-white checkered vinyl tablecloth, a stained-glass hanging lamp glowing directly above. Warm stained-glass lamp glow, saturated reds and ambers, nostalgic 1993 dine-in pizza parlor. 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, rich contrast. Square crop, subject centered and filling the frame. Deadpan hyperreal advertising realism. No text, no logos, no packaging labels, no hands, no people.

items.imagePrompt: Ultra-premium commercial food photography for a delivery-app menu tile. Subject: a clean vertical cross-section cutaway of an extremely deep pan pizza, one wedge removed to expose stratified layers from top to bottom: a blistered cheese cap, a seam of sausage crumble, a dense cheese band, a second buried crust layer running horizontally through the middle, a thick red sauce stratum, and a fused caramelized crust wall against the black steel pan. Cheese slumps outward from the cut face under its own weight, oil beading on the exposed layers, faint steam. Shot on a red-and-white checkered vinyl tablecloth beside a chrome pizza stand, warm stained-glass lamp glow directly above, saturated reds and ambers, 1993 dine-in pizza parlor. 100mm macro lens, crisp layer separation. Square crop, subject centered and filling the frame. Deadpan hyperreal advertising realism. No text, no logos, no packaging labels, no hands, no people.

items.name: Covenant Breadsticks
items.desc: Twenty garlic-buttered sticks under a standard twelve-month covenant. The covenant governs the sticks, not you, though the distinction is administrative.
items.imagePrompt: Ultra-premium commercial food photography for a delivery-app menu tile. Subject: a dented aluminum sheet tray lined with grease-translucent paper, stacked with twenty thick garlic breadsticks in a leaning, overloaded pile that spills past the tray's edge. Melted butter pools in the liner and soaks a dark ring through the paper, coarse garlic granules and parmesan dust scattered across the surface, one stick torn open to show a soft steaming interior. Tray sits on a red-and-white checkered vinyl tablecloth, chrome pizza stand behind it, stained-glass hanging lamp glowing directly above. Warm stained-glass lamp glow, saturated reds and ambers, nostalgic 1993 dine-in pizza parlor. 50mm lens, low three-quarter angle, gentle depth falloff. Square crop, subject centered and filling the frame. Deadpan hyperreal advertising realism. No text, no logos, no packaging labels, no hands, no people.

Harsh direct on-camera flash, hot blown-out white hotspot on the sauce, hard black shadow thrown behind the tray. Cluttered background: a stainless prep counter, a napkin dispenser, a stack of lids and another order waiting in a box. Flat phone-camera look, unretouched, mixed white balance. Square crop.
